sections.title: Getting started
sections.body: Upload one or more videos, assign each subject an ID, choose a sampling mode, and optionally configure stimuli. Extraction produces facial predictions, visualizations, and a Parquet file.

sections.title: Sampling
sections.body: Frame-level sampling preserves more temporal detail. Approximately 1 FPS or a custom frequency reduces the number of analyzed frames.

sections.title: Stimuli
sections.body: Intervals are set in seconds relative to the start of each video. Each recording can have its own windows or share windows with the other videos.

sections.title: Interpretation
sections.body: Model predictions are estimates to support analysis. Inspect the data and consider the experimental context before drawing conclusions.
